title: Assertion
description: A post-execution check. A failed mandatory assertion rolls the plan back.

target.description: An element reference: '$result.<opId>' or an explicit reference.

equals.description: Expected value (number, string, or nested object depending on kind).

expect.description: For element_exists / element_count: true or false / exact count.

parameter.description: Parameter name or GUID for parameter_equals / parameter_not_empty.

host.description: Reference to the expected host element.

region.description: For bounding_box_within: { min: {x,y,z}, max: {x,y,z} } in plan units.
